final: {"prompt":"A square, purely nonrepresentational abstract painting filling the entire image edge to edge. Translate the tension between many possible continuations and one committed gesture into paint. A spacious field of smoky ultramarine and warm bone-white carries translucent layers of violet, graphite gray, and muted rose. Across the lower-left quadrant, dense, restless brushwork accumulates: scraped pigment, dry scumbles, thick impasto, and half-buried strokes that interrupt and revise one another. Small concentrations of electric coral and sharp chartreuse create irregular pulses within this density. Toward the upper right, the paint thins into luminous, nearly empty space, with subtle traces of earlier layers remaining visible. One broad, asymmetrical sweep of saturated cobalt crosses the boundary between crowded and open areas, its edges alternating between decisive and dissolved. Let repetitions almost establish a rhythm, then break it. Preserve awkward pauses, unresolved overlaps, exposed underpainting, and areas of quiet restraint. Make the surface tactile, searching, and materially convincing, with strong spatial tension and no central emblem. Every mark must remain abstract. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. No frame, wall, room, or gallery setting; only the square painting, filling the entire image."}

prompt:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

Write a complete image prompt. Do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
